manifest.policy: Repeated first integration at rest; reset x/v/rho/p/history outside timer, retain valid main adjacency; native searches every call. Default DF/CD stop tests, not forced iteration counts.
manifest.boundary_policy: Local sampled walls/contactShepard plus auxiliary frozen contour; native Akinci2012 sampled walls/self pressure. Common cubic4dx primary; current C4/4dx overlay.
manifest.pre_measurement_amendment: Use common dt below both viscosity bounds at high resolution; no measurements preceded this correction.
manifest.cpu_affinity: OMP_PLACES={0},...,{7}; OMP_PROC_BIND=close; OMP_DYNAMIC=FALSE. CPU threads use P cores (0–7) on Ultra9 285K. Full-CPU control: 24 threads bound to cores0–23 (8P+16E), same stopping/numerical settings.
